title: Asajj Ventress
subtitle: Ambitious Apprentice
text: Action [Exhaust]: Attack with a token unit. It gets +1/+0 for this attack.
deployBox:
Hidden (This unit can't be attacked if she was deployed this phase.) 
While you've attacked with a token unit this phase, this unit gets +2/+0.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 5 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules:
If you use Asajj’s leader ability, you must attack with a unit, if able. Units must be ready in order to attack.
If a unit has Hidden and Sentinel at the same time, it can be attacked.
